note: Typical ranges across published FDDs. Brands vary. Verify every figure in the brand's current FDD.

items.name: Quick-service burger restaurant
items.summary: High-volume drive-thru model with proven menus and national purchasing power.
items.watch: Real estate and build-out dominate cost; labor scheduling makes or breaks margin.

items.name: Pizza delivery & carryout
items.summary: Small footprint, delivery-heavy sales and simple kitchen workflow.
items.watch: Third-party delivery fees and driver staffing squeeze unit margins.

items.name: Fast-casual bowls & salads
items.summary: Health-forward menus with lunch-heavy traffic in suburban and office areas.
items.watch: Lunch dependence; check daypart mix in Item 19 if disclosed.

items.name: Specialty coffee café
items.summary: Repeat daily visits, drive-thru formats growing fastest.
items.watch: Morning rush staffing and real-estate visibility are critical.

items.name: Coffee kiosk / drive-thru hut
items.summary: Low square footage and fast service with high beverage margins.
items.watch: Site approvals and traffic patterns drive almost all results.

items.name: Smoothie & juice bar
items.summary: Health-led beverages with simple prep and strong add-on sales.
items.watch: Seasonality and produce costs; mall or strip location matters.

items.name: Frozen dessert & ice cream
items.summary: Treat-driven traffic with high gross margins on product.
items.watch: Strong seasonality outside warm climates.

items.name: Cookie & bakery shop
items.summary: Gifting, catering and delivery broaden sales beyond walk-ins.
items.watch: Early-morning production labor and shelf-life waste.

items.name: Chicken wings & sandwiches
items.summary: Strong takeout and delivery demand with sports-season peaks.
items.watch: Commodity chicken price swings hit food cost.

items.name: Sub & sandwich shop
items.summary: Simple operations, catering add-ons and non-traditional sites.
items.watch: Saturated in many markets; check territory protection closely.

items.name: Food truck / mobile kitchen
items.summary: Event, office-park and festival sales without a lease.
items.watch: Weather, permits and vehicle downtime.

items.name: Boutique fitness studio
items.summary: Membership revenue with class-based scheduling and premium pricing.
items.watch: Instructor retention and member churn after the first year.

items.name: Full-size 24-hour gym
items.summary: Low monthly price, high member count, mostly unstaffed hours.
items.watch: Large build-out and equipment leases; competitive markets.

items.name: Pilates & reformer studio
items.summary: One of the fastest-growing studio formats with high per-class pricing.
items.watch: Trend risk; check unit closures in Item 20.

items.name: Stretch & recovery studio
items.summary: Assisted stretching and recovery memberships for active and older clients.
items.watch: Newer category; validate repeat-visit rates with owners.

items.name: Kids' sports & fitness programs
items.summary: Coaches run classes at schools, parks and daycares — no storefront.
items.watch: Owner does sales and scheduling; growth needs coaches.

items.name: Indoor pickleball club
items.summary: Membership courts, leagues and events in large-format spaces.
items.watch: Very large lease or purchase; newer models with limited history.

items.name: Med spa & aesthetics
items.summary: Injectables, laser and skin services with membership pricing.
items.watch: Medical director rules vary by state or province.

items.name: Massage & spa membership
items.summary: Monthly membership model with therapist-delivered services.
items.watch: Therapist recruitment is the constant constraint.

items.name: IV hydration & wellness lounge
items.summary: Drip therapy and wellness add-ons in compact clinics.
items.watch: Clinical oversight and regulatory scrutiny.

items.name: Hair salon / blow-dry bar
items.summary: Stylist-driven services with retail product upsell.
items.watch: Stylist turnover; suite-rental competition.

items.name: Salon suites (rental)
items.summary: Rent private suites to independent beauty pros — landlord-style income.
items.watch: Lease size and occupancy ramp-up period.

items.name: Kids' haircuts
items.summary: Family-focused salon with entertainment for children.
items.watch: Small ticket; volume and location are everything.

items.name: Waxing & brow studio
items.summary: Recurring personal-care visits with membership options.
items.watch: Esthetician licensing and staffing.

items.name: Residential maid service
items.summary: Recurring weekly and biweekly cleans create predictable revenue.
items.watch: Hiring and retaining cleaners is the whole game.

items.name: Commercial janitorial
items.summary: Contract cleaning of offices and facilities, often via a regional master.
items.watch: Some models sell you accounts — read Item 11 and 19 carefully.

items.name: Carpet & upholstery cleaning
items.summary: Van-based service with residential and commercial customers.
items.watch: Equipment financing and seasonality.

items.name: Water, fire & mold restoration
items.summary: Insurance-driven emergency work with high average tickets.
items.watch: Long receivables cycles with insurance carriers.

items.name: Window cleaning & pressure washing
items.summary: Low-overhead exterior services with recurring commercial routes.
items.watch: Weather and seasonality in northern markets.

items.name: Junk removal & hauling
items.summary: Truck-based service with strong demand from moves and renovations.
items.watch: Disposal fees and truck maintenance.

items.name: Non-medical senior home care
items.summary: Caregivers support older adults at home; aging demographics drive demand.
items.watch: Caregiver recruiting, overtime rules and payer mix.

items.name: Senior placement & advisory
items.summary: Help families choose care communities; paid by communities on move-in.
items.watch: Referral-fee rules differ by state; relationship-driven.

items.name: Chiropractic clinic
items.summary: Cash-based membership chiropractic, no insurance billing.
items.watch: Doctor recruitment and corporate practice laws.

items.name: Physical therapy / rehab clinic
items.summary: Outpatient care with referral and insurance revenue.
items.watch: Insurance reimbursement rates and clinician supply.

items.name: Hearing & vision services
items.summary: Testing and devices for an aging population.
items.watch: Clinical licensing; big-box retail competition.

items.name: Drug testing & background screening
items.summary: B2B testing for employers with repeat contracts.
items.watch: Lab partnerships and regulatory updates.

items.name: Tutoring & learning center
items.summary: After-school academic support with monthly enrollment.
items.watch: Seasonal enrollment; online tutoring competition.

items.name: Kids' coding & STEM center
items.summary: Coding, robotics and camps with subscription pricing.
items.watch: Instructor quality; tech curriculum updates.

items.name: Early education / child care center
items.summary: Licensed child care with long enrollment lifetimes.
items.watch: Very large build-out, licensing and staffing ratios.

items.name: Mobile kids' enrichment
items.summary: Dance, art, science or sports classes delivered at partner sites.
items.watch: Owner-led sales; income caps without hiring instructors.

items.name: Swim school
items.summary: Year-round lessons with high member retention.
items.watch: Pool construction cost and lifeguard staffing.

items.name: Music & arts school
items.summary: Lessons, bands and camps with monthly tuition.
items.watch: Teacher scheduling and room utilization.

items.name: Pet grooming (mobile)
items.summary: Van-based grooming at the customer's home with recurring appointments.
items.watch: Groomer recruiting; van financing.

items.name: Dog daycare & boarding
items.summary: Daycare memberships plus overnight boarding and grooming.
items.watch: Large facility, zoning and noise rules.

items.name: Pet waste removal
items.summary: Recurring yard service with very low overhead.
items.watch: Route density takes time to build.

items.name: Pet supply & wash store
items.summary: Natural food and self-wash stations in neighborhood retail.
items.watch: Online pet retail competition.

items.name: Dog training
items.summary: In-home and group training programs.
items.watch: Trainer certification and lead generation.

items.name: Lawn care & landscaping
items.summary: Recurring seasonal service with upsells like aeration and lighting.
items.watch: Short season in cold climates.

items.name: Residential painting
items.summary: Crew-based painting run by a manager-owner; low equipment cost.
items.watch: Crew labor availability and weather.

items.name: Handyman & home repair
items.summary: Small jobs with high demand from busy and aging homeowners.
items.watch: Technician recruiting and licensing rules.

items.name: Plumbing / HVAC / electrical
items.summary: Essential trades with maintenance-plan recurring revenue.
items.watch: Licensed-tech shortages; some markets need a licensed qualifier.

items.name: Pest control
items.summary: Quarterly service plans give strong recurring revenue.
items.watch: Chemical licensing and regulation.

items.name: Pool cleaning & repair
items.summary: Weekly routes in warm climates.
items.watch: Climate-limited markets.

items.name: Roofing & exteriors
items.summary: High-ticket projects with insurance-claim work.
items.watch: Storm-driven demand can be lumpy.

items.name: Closet & garage organization
items.summary: Custom storage design and install with high average tickets.
items.watch: Showroom optional; installer staffing.

items.name: Bathroom & kitchen remodeling
items.summary: Design-build projects with large tickets and financing options.
items.watch: Project management and subcontractor quality.

items.name: Home inspection
items.summary: Inspections for buyers, sellers and insurers.
items.watch: Tied to housing-market volume.

items.name: Real estate brokerage
items.summary: Recruit agents under a national brand and share commissions.
items.watch: Agent splits and cyclical housing markets.

items.name: Tax preparation office
items.summary: Seasonal tax work with year-round bookkeeping add-ons.
items.watch: Heavy seasonality; DIY software competition.

items.name: Business coaching & consulting
items.summary: Coach small-business owners on growth with monthly retainers.
items.watch: You sell your own expertise; slow start without a network.

items.name: Staffing & recruiting
items.summary: Temporary and permanent placement for local employers.
items.watch: Payroll funding and economic cycles.

items.name: Print, sign & marketing center
items.summary: B2B printing, signage and marketing services.
items.watch: Equipment leases; shift to digital marketing.

items.name: Shipping, print & mailbox store
items.summary: Shipping, notary and print services with steady foot traffic.
items.watch: Carrier rate changes affect margins.

items.name: Phone & electronics repair
items.summary: Repairs and refurbished devices in small retail units.
items.watch: Manufacturer self-repair programs.

items.name: Mattress & sleep store
items.summary: Specialty retail with appointment-based selling.
items.watch: Online mattress competition.

items.name: Convenience store
items.summary: Daily-needs retail with fuel or food-service add-ons.
items.watch: Thin margins; long hours.

items.name: Vending & micro-markets
items.summary: Unattended retail in offices and facilities.
items.watch: Location contracts and restocking routes.

items.name: Oil change & quick lube
items.summary: Fast, high-frequency service with membership plans.
items.watch: Real estate cost and EV adoption over time.

items.name: Auto repair & tire service
items.summary: Full-service repair with fleet and warranty work.
items.watch: Technician shortage.

items.name: Mobile auto detailing
items.summary: Van-based detailing and ceramic coatings.
items.watch: Weather and owner-labor dependence.

items.name: Express car wash
items.summary: Unlimited wash memberships with minimal staff.
items.watch: Land, equipment and permitting costs are very high.

items.name: Escape room & experience venue
items.summary: Group bookings, corporate events and parties.
items.watch: Content refresh costs; novelty wears off.

items.name: Family entertainment center
items.summary: Trampoline, climbing or arcade venues with party revenue.
items.watch: Insurance, safety and large lease.

items.name: Travel agency (home-based)
items.summary: Sell cruises and tours from home with host-agency support.
items.watch: Commission-only income ramps slowly.

items.name: Select-service hotel
items.summary: Brand-affiliated lodging with reservation systems and loyalty programs.
items.watch: Capital intensive; long development timelines.
